articles.summary: SR200 Product Brief Product / Astra Embedded Processors / Astra SR200 Series Introducing SR200 Read More Product / Astra Embedded Processors / Astra SR200 Series Defining a New Silicon Class for the AI-Native Edge Read More Product Overview The Synaptics Astra SR200 Series of AI-native MCUs delivers high-performance, low-power multimodal compute for wearables, connected cameras, and industrial vision and voice systems. Powered by the Synaptics Torq™ AI engine with Google Research’s Coral NPU™, the series provides 400 GOPS of AI inference alongside Arm® Cortex®-M85 and Cortex®-M52 cores. Its integrated vision, display, and audio pipelines support applications such as camera processing, rich user interfaces, wake-word detection, and voice processing. A multi-die system-in-package design combines compute, power management, and high-capacity memory to improve design efficiency and reduce system power and cost. With advanced security, broad connectivity, Zephyr RTOS support, and an open-source NPU compiler, SR200 MCUs enable a new class of edge and physical AI devices. Media MCU Efficiency. By leveraging the integrated vision and audio architecture, extensible DRAM support, and high-efficiency Torq™ NPU of the Synaptics Astra® SR200 Series, we can execute complex scene understanding, low-latency overlay rendering, and continuous voice processing on a single, highly integrated SoC. Astra's scalable edge compute, audio processing, and low power performance are the kind of capabilities that matter as we push what's possible in audio,"" said Kurt Preston, Chief Supply Chain Officer, Sonos. ""Delivering that requires partnership across every level of the organization, from joint development to production that scales with us."
